subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should OpenClaw merge this Wear status module before it is wired into the official Android release and installation path?
rationale: The code can be technically repaired, but repository evidence does not determine whether dormant Wear code is an intentional staged product milestone or whether the first merged slice must be distributable to users.

options.title: Complete the distributable slice
options.body: Require localization and an explicit signed Wear packaging, publishing, installation, and update path before merging the new application surface.

options.title: Approve a staged dormant module
options.body: Merge after localization and CI repair while explicitly documenting that no official release contains the Wear APK yet and naming the follow-up release owner.

options.title: Pause Wear product work
options.body: Close or defer the PR if the Android roadmap does not currently sponsor a Wear companion surface.

recommendation.title: Complete the distributable slice
recommendation.body: Require localization and an explicit signed Wear packaging, publishing, installation, and update path before merging the new application surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly routes Android app work to @obviyus, and this decision spans Android product scope, application packaging, and release behavior.
